textual.observation: The video promotes an external website that allegedly generates Lowe's discount promo codes, and instructs viewers to copy a generated code and apply it to a Lowe's purchase for a stated discount.

evidence.quote: It'll generate a promo code for you.
And it'll. Refresh the page and get 10% off your purchase

textual.context: Presented as a promotional demonstration; the source records do not establish whether the codes or external website function as described.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised purchase discount is linked to visiting an external destination and copying, applying, and potentially repeatedly generating promo codes, which may require later assessment of the offer and destination.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the external website, the promo codes, Lowe's authorization, or whether any discount was actually received.

visual.observation: A webpage branded with Lowe's logos presents selectable offers for "10% OFF ALL ONLINE ORDERS" and "$10 OFF $50 ONLINE ORDER," stating that a promo code will be individually generated for use on lowes.com.
visual.context: The offer is shown on a third-party-looking webpage whose visible address includes renovpower.com; the page directs the viewer to use the code on lowes.com.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed retail discount is linked to selecting or obtaining a generated code from the external page and then using it at a branded retailer destination, creating a promotion-and-destination relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish affiliation with Lowe's, whether the codes work, whether the page redirects successfully, or whether any purchase or loss occurred.

visual.observation: A code-detail page states that a promo code was "individually generated" for a $10 discount on a $50-or-more online order at Lowe's, and instructs the viewer to refresh the page or press F5 if the code was already used.
visual.context: The text is presented as an offer or demonstration on the same external webpage; the visible page includes an expiration date and a minimum-order condition.
visual.potential_relevance: A specific monetary discount and expiration condition are tied to obtaining and using a generated code through the page, which is a concrete reward-and-action relationship.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not verify the code, the stated expiration, the page's affiliation, or any resulting transaction.

textual_context_notes.observation: The description includes a disclaimer that the uploader does not own or accept responsibility for the linked website.

evidence.quote: I AM NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR ANYTHING ON RENOVOPOWER. I am not the owner of this site.

visual_context_notes.observation: The page displays a user comment claiming, "This is so cool I don't know how to thank you guys - you saved me $10 and it only took me 5 seconds to copy and paste the promo code from your web site to lowes.com."
The webpage repeatedly asks viewers to leave feedback in a comments area after successfully using a free promo code.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes an external website as a generator of Lowe's discount codes and presents specific percentage or dollar savings to viewers. It instructs viewers to obtain a generated code and apply or refresh it for a Lowe's purchase. The records do not verify Lowe's authorization, code validity, successful redemption, or any resulting loss, and the uploader disclaims ownership of the external site.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central mechanism presented is a purported promo-code generator: the speaker says the external site generates codes, directs viewers to copy one, and links using it to a claimed purchase discount. This supports an offered benefit-bypass mechanism, but does not establish that any code works or that a purchase or discount occurred.
